\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R157-first-pass-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to burn and to put out; to hug.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item famous, dangerous, safe, true, false
  \item purple, grey; ash, to sing, to cook, to cut
  \item to break, to put, to send, to look for, to teach
  \item to forget, to jump, to swim, to fly, to fall
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Famous? (\textbf{\ta{பிரபலமான}}, \emph{pirapalamāṉa}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\ta{ஆபத்தான}}, \emph{āpattāṉa}.) Safe? (\textbf{\ta{பாதுகாப்பான}}, \emph{pātukāppāṉa}.) True? (\textbf{\ta{உண்மையான}}, \emph{uṇmaiyāṉa}.) False? (\textbf{\ta{பொய்யான}}, \emph{poyyāṉa}.) Purple? (\textbf{\ta{ஊதா}}, \emph{ūtā}.) Grey; ash? (\textbf{\ta{சாம்பல்}}, \emph{cāmpal}.) To sing? (\textbf{\ta{பாடு}}, \emph{pāṭu}.) To cook? (\textbf{\ta{சமை}}, \emph{camai}.) To cut? (\textbf{\ta{வெட்டு}}, \emph{veṭṭu}.) To break? (\textbf{\ta{உடை}}, \emph{uṭai}.) To put? (\textbf{\ta{வை}}, \emph{vai}.) To send? (\textbf{\ta{அனுப்பு}}, \emph{anuppu}.) To look for? (\textbf{\ta{தேடு}}, \emph{tēṭu}.) To teach? (\textbf{\ta{கற்பி}}, \emph{kaṟpi}.) To forget? (\textbf{\ta{மற}}, \emph{maṟa}.) To jump? (\textbf{\ta{குதி}}, \emph{kuti}.) To swim? (\textbf{\ta{நீந்து}}, \emph{nīntu}.) To fly? (\textbf{\ta{பற}}, \emph{paṟa}.) To fall? (\textbf{\ta{விழு}}, \emph{viḻu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R157-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to climb and to get down.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to climb, to get down, to turn, to join, to bathe
  \item to wear, to call, to grow, to count, to shout
  \item to push, to pull, to put, to tie, to wash
  \item to wipe, to sweep, to learn, to win, to find
  \item to hide, to save, to blow, to burn, to put out; to hug
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To climb? (\textbf{\ta{ஏறு}}, \emph{ēṟu}.) To get down? (\textbf{\ta{இறங்கு}}, \emph{iṟaṅku}.) To turn? (\textbf{\ta{திரும்பு}}, \emph{tirumpu}.) To join? (\textbf{\ta{சேர்}}, \emph{cēr}.) To bathe? (\textbf{\ta{குளி}}, \emph{kuḷi}.) To wear? (\textbf{\ta{அணி}}, \emph{aṇi}.) To call? (\textbf{\ta{அழை}}, \emph{aḻai}.) To grow? (\textbf{\ta{வளர்}}, \emph{vaḷar}.) To count? (\textbf{\ta{எண்ணு}}, \emph{eṇṇu}.) To shout? (\textbf{\ta{கத்து}}, \emph{kattu}.) To push? (\textbf{\ta{தள்ளு}}, \emph{taḷḷu}.) To pull? (\textbf{\ta{இழு}}, \emph{iḻu}.) To put? (\textbf{\ta{போடு}}, \emph{pōṭu}.) To tie? (\textbf{\ta{கட்டு}}, \emph{kaṭṭu}.) To wash? (\textbf{\ta{துவை}}, \emph{tuvai}.) To wipe? (\textbf{\ta{துடை}}, \emph{tuṭai}.) To sweep? (\textbf{\ta{பெருக்கு}}, \emph{perukku}.) To learn? (\textbf{\ta{கற்றுக்கொள்}}, \emph{kaṟṟukkoḷ}.) To win? (\textbf{\ta{வெல்}}, \emph{vel}.) To find? (\textbf{\ta{கண்டுபிடி}}, \emph{kaṇṭupiṭi}.) To hide? (\textbf{\ta{மறை}}, \emph{maṟai}.) To save? (\textbf{\ta{காப்பாற்று}}, \emph{kāppāṟṟu}.) To blow? (\textbf{\ta{ஊது}}, \emph{ūtu}.) To burn? (\textbf{\ta{எரி}}, \emph{eri}.) To put out; to hug? (\textbf{\ta{அணை}}, \emph{aṇai}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
